---
params:
  lang: cs
date: today
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    code-fold: true
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 2
    # AOPK ČR web style (Grafický manuál AOPK 2026 – WEB): palette and type in
    # aopk.scss, fonts, header, footer and widgets in page.css
    theme: [cosmo, assets/aopk.scss]
    css: assets/page.css
    title-block-banner: true
    fig-responsive: true
execute:
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(DT)
library(htmltools)
library(yaml)
library(here)

source(here("R", "i18n.R"))

lang <- params$lang
strings <- read_strings()
tr <- translator(strings, lang)
fmt_num <- number_formatter(tr)
fmt_date <- date_formatter(lang)
tr_kves <- kves_translator(strings, lang)
tr_count_unit <- count_unit_translator(strings, lang)
fmt_pct <- \(x) tr("fmt_pct", x = fmt_num(x, 0.1))
fmt_pclass <- \(lo, hi) paste0(fmt_num(lo, 0.1), "–", fmt_num(hi, 0.1))

# Processed data only (see R/02_process.R and R/03_web.R)
proc <- here("data", "processed")
meta <- read_yaml(file.path(proc, "metadata.yml"))
web_meta <- read_yaml(file.path(proc, "web_metadata.yml"))
site_summary <- read_csv(file.path(proc, "site_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
breakdown <- read_csv(file.path(proc, "habitat_breakdown.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
site_bounds <- read_csv(file.path(proc, "site_bounds.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
sites_web <- st_read(file.path(proc, "web_layers.gpkg"), layer = "sites_web", quiet = TRUE)
habitat_web <- st_read(file.path(proc, "web_layers.gpkg"), layer = "habitat_web", quiet = TRUE)
occurrences_web <- st_read(file.path(proc, "web_layers.gpkg"), layer = "occurrences_web",
                           quiet = TRUE)
ndop_year <- format(as.Date(meta$ndop$date_from), "%Y")
# Formatted record counts after each selection step, e.g. ndop_n$positive[["teleius"]]
ndop_n <- map(meta$ndop$n_records, \(x) map_chr(x, \(n) fmt_num(n, 1)))

# Colour-blind-safe pair (validated: worst CVD delta E 24.7); teleius sites dashed
species_info <- tibble(
  species = c("nausithous", "teleius"),
  latin = c("Phengaris nausithous", "Phengaris teleius"),
  colour = c("#2a78d6", "#eb6834"),
  dash = c(NA, "6 4")
) |>
  mutate(common = map_chr(species, \(s) tr(paste0("sp_", s))))

site_tbl <- site_summary |>
  left_join(species_info, by = "species")

n_sites <- unlist(meta$n_sites)
n_both <- site_summary |> count(site_code) |> filter(n == 2) |> nrow()
p_min_lab <- fmt_num(meta$p_min, 0.1)
p_class_labs <- fmt_pclass(head(meta$p_breaks, -1), meta$p_breaks[-1])

# DataTables UI strings
dt_language <- list(
  search = tr("dt_search"),
  lengthMenu = tr("dt_length_menu"),
  info = tr("dt_info"),
  infoEmpty = tr("dt_info_empty"),
  infoFiltered = tr("dt_info_filtered"),
  zeroRecords = tr("dt_zero_records"),
  thousands = tr("big_mark"),
  decimal = tr("decimal_mark"),
  paginate = list(
    first = tr("dt_first"), last = tr("dt_last"),
    `next` = tr("dt_next"), previous = tr("dt_previous")
  )
)
```

## `r tr("sec_map")` {#map}

`r tr("map_intro", year = ndop_year)`

```{r}
#| label: site-zoom
# Site picker and zoom function (also used by the summary table)
site_choices <- site_tbl |>
  distinct(site_code, site_name) |>
  arrange(str_rank(site_name, locale = "cs"))

# Bounds as [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] per site code, plus "_all"
site_bbox <- pmap(select(site_bounds, xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), \(...) unname(c(...)))
bounds <- c(
  list(`_all` = with(site_bounds, c(min(xmin), min(ymin), max(xmax), max(ymax)))),
  set_names(site_bbox, site_bounds$site_code)
)

zoom_js <- sprintf(
  "window.phengarisBounds = %s;
window.phengarisZoom = function(code, scroll) {
  var el = document.getElementById('overview-map');
  var widget = el ? HTMLWidgets.find('#overview-map') : null;
  var b = window.phengarisBounds[code || '_all'];
  if (!widget || !b) return;
  widget.getMap().fitBounds([[b[1], b[0]], [b[3], b[2]]], {padding: [20, 20]});
  var sel = document.getElementById('site-zoom');
  if (sel) sel.value = code || '';
  if (window.phengarisBreakdown) window.phengarisBreakdown.search(code || '').draw();
  if (scroll) el.scrollIntoView({behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center'});
};",
  jsonlite::toJSON(bounds, digits = 6, auto_unbox = FALSE)
)

tagList(
  div(
    class = "site-zoom",
    tags$label(`for` = "site-zoom", tr("zoom_label")),
    tags$select(
      id = "site-zoom",
      onchange = "phengarisZoom(this.value, false)",
      tags$option(value = "", tr("zoom_all")),
      map2(site_choices$site_code, site_choices$site_name,
           \(code, name) tags$option(value = code, sprintf("%s (%s)", name, code)))
    )
  ),
  tags$script(HTML(zoom_js))
)
```

```{r}
#| label: map
fmt_ha <- \(x) paste(fmt_num(x, 0.1), tr("unit_ha"))

# One popup per site, listing every species the site is designated for
site_popups <- site_tbl |>
  arrange(site_code, species) |>
  mutate(sp_html = sprintf(
    "<hr><b>%s</b> (<i>%s</i>)<br>%s: %s (%s %s)<br>%s: %s%s",
    htmlEscape(common), latin, tr("pop_hab_area"), fmt_ha(habitat_ha),
    fmt_pct(cover_pct), tr("pop_cover"),
    tr("pop_records", year = ndop_year), fmt_num(n_records, 1),
    if_else(n_records > 0,
            sprintf(" (%s %s)", tr("pop_last_record"), fmt_date(last_record)), "")
  )) |>
  group_by(site_code, site_name, site_area_ha) |>
  summarise(sp_html = paste(sp_html, collapse = ""), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(popup = sprintf(
    "<b>%s</b><br>%s: %s<br>%s: %s%s",
    htmlEscape(site_name), tr("pop_site_code"), site_code,
    tr("pop_site_area"), fmt_ha(site_area_ha), sp_html
  ))

habitat_map <- habitat_web |>
  left_join(species_info, by = "species") |>
  mutate(popup = sprintf(
    "<b>%s</b> (<i>%s</i>)<br>%s: %s<br>%s: %s<br>%s: %s<br>%s: %s",
    htmlEscape(common), latin,
    tr("pop_site"), htmlEscape(sprintf("%s (%s)", site_name, site_code)),
    tr("pop_kves"), htmlEscape(tr_kves(kves)),
    tr("pop_pclass"), fmt_pclass(p_class_lower, p_class_upper),
    tr("pop_patch_area"), fmt_ha(area_ha)
  ))

occ_map <- occurrences_web |>
  left_join(species_info, by = "species") |>
  mutate(
    date = if_else(date_to == date_from, fmt_date(date_from),
                   paste(fmt_date(date_from), "–", fmt_date(date_to))),
    unit_lab = map_chr(count_unit, \(u) if (u == "") "" else tr_count_unit(u)),
    count_details = paste0(
      unit_lab,
      if_else(unit_lab != "" & count_estimated, "; ", ""),
      if_else(count_estimated, tr("pop_occ_estimated"), "")
    ),
    count_html = case_when(
      is.na(count) ~ "",
      count_details == "" ~ sprintf("<br>%s: %s", tr("pop_occ_count"), fmt_num(count, 1)),
      .default = sprintf("<br>%s: %s (%s)", tr("pop_occ_count"), fmt_num(count, 1),
                         htmlEscape(count_details))
    ),
    popup = sprintf(
      "<b>%s</b> (<i>%s</i>)<br>%s: %s%s<br>%s: %s<br>%s: %s %s<br>%s: %s<br>%s: %s",
      htmlEscape(common), latin,
      tr("pop_occ_date"), date, count_html,
      tr("pop_occ_validation"), map_chr(validation, \(v) tr(paste0("val_", v))),
      tr("pop_occ_accuracy"), fmt_num(accuracy_m, 1), tr("unit_m"),
      tr("pop_site"), htmlEscape(sprintf("%s (%s)", site_name, site_code)),
      tr("pop_occ_id"), ndop_id
    )
  )

m <- leaflet(elementId = "overview-map", width = "100%", height = 650) |>
  addMapPane("pane_sites", zIndex = 410) |>
  addMapPane("pane_habitat", zIndex = 420) |>
  addMapPane("pane_occurrences", zIndex = 430) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap, group = tr("base_osm")) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = tr("base_aerial"))

for (sp in species_info$species) {
  info <- filter(species_info, species == sp)
  sp_sites <- sites_web |>
    semi_join(filter(site_tbl, species == sp), by = "site_code") |>
    left_join(select(site_popups, site_code, site_name, popup), by = "site_code")
  m <- m |>
    addPolygons(
      data = sp_sites, group = tr(paste0("grp_sites_", sp)),
      color = info$colour, weight = 2.5, opacity = 1,
      dashArray = if (is.na(info$dash)) NULL else info$dash,
      fillColor = info$colour, fillOpacity = 0.04,
      label = ~site_name, popup = ~popup,
      options = pathOptions(pane = "pane_sites")
    )
}

for (sp in species_info$species) {
  info <- filter(species_info, species == sp)
  m <- m |>
    addPolygons(
      data = filter(habitat_map, species == sp), group = tr(paste0("grp_hab_", sp)),
      color = info$colour, weight = 0.6, opacity = 0.9,
      fillColor = info$colour, fillOpacity = 0.55,
      popup = ~popup,
      options = pathOptions(pane = "pane_habitat")
    )
}

# White border sets the dots apart from habitat patches of the same colour
for (sp in species_info$species) {
  info <- filter(species_info, species == sp)
  m <- m |>
    addCircleMarkers(
      data = filter(occ_map, species == sp),
      group = tr(paste0("grp_occ_", sp), year = ndop_year),
      radius = 5, color = "#ffffff", weight = 1.5, opacity = 1,
      fillColor = info$colour, fillOpacity = 1,
      popup = ~popup,
      options = pathOptions(pane = "pane_occurrences")
    )
}

legend_row <- function(swatch_style, label, swatch_class = "legend-swatch") {
  div(class = "legend-row", span(class = swatch_class, style = swatch_style), label)
}
legend_html <- tagList(
  tags$strong(tr("legend_title")),
  pmap(species_info, \(species, colour, dash, ...) {
    border <- if (is.na(dash)) "solid" else "dashed"
    tagList(
      legend_row(sprintf("border: 2.5px %s %s;", border, colour),
                 tr(paste0("grp_sites_", species))),
      legend_row(sprintf("background: %s; opacity: 0.7;", colour),
                 tr(paste0("grp_hab_", species))),
      legend_row(sprintf("background: %s;", colour),
                 tr(paste0("grp_occ_", species), year = ndop_year), "legend-dot")
    )
  })
)

all_bounds <- bounds[["_all"]]
m <- m |>
  addControl(html = as.character(legend_html), position = "bottomright",
             className = "info legend phengaris-legend") |>
  addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft", options = scaleBarOptions(imperial = FALSE)) |>
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c(tr("base_osm"), tr("base_aerial")),
    overlayGroups = c(
      map_chr(species_info$species, \(s) tr(paste0("grp_sites_", s))),
      map_chr(species_info$species, \(s) tr(paste0("grp_hab_", s))),
      map_chr(species_info$species, \(s) tr(paste0("grp_occ_", s), year = ndop_year))
    ),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) |>
  fitBounds(all_bounds[1], all_bounds[2], all_bounds[3], all_bounds[4])

# Fixed decimal places: htmlwidgets otherwise counts significant digits, and
# 5 significant digits would snap every vertex to a ~100 m grid
attr(m$x, "TOJSON_ARGS") <- list(digits = web_meta$coord_digits, use_signif = FALSE)
m
```

## `r tr("sec_table")` {#table}

`r tr("table_intro")`

```{r}
#| label: summary-table
#| column: page-left
summary_tbl <- site_tbl |>
  arrange(species, desc(habitat_ha), site_code) |>
  transmute(
    !!tr("col_site_code") := site_code,
    !!tr("col_site_name") := site_name,
    !!tr("col_species") := common,
    !!tr("col_site_area") := site_area_ha,
    !!tr("col_hab_area") := habitat_ha,
    !!tr("col_cover") := cover_pct,
    !!tr("col_below", p_min = p_min_lab) := below_threshold_ha,
    !!tr("col_n_straddle") := n_straddling,
    !!tr("col_cut_off") := cut_off_ha,
    !!tr("col_flag") := if_else(flag_zero_habitat, tr("flag_zero"), "")
  )

num_cols <- names(summary_tbl)[4:9]
datatable(
  summary_tbl,
  elementId = "summary-table",
  rownames = FALSE,
  selection = "none",
  class = "compact hover",
  options = list(
    language = dt_language,
    pageLength = 15,
    lengthMenu = c(15, 30, 60),
    order = list(),
    scrollX = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(list(className = "dt-right", targets = 3:8))
  ),
  callback = JS(
    "table.on('click', 'tbody tr', function() {",
    "  var d = table.row(this).data();",
    "  if (d) phengarisZoom(d[0], true);",
    "});"
  )
) |>
  formatRound(num_cols[-5], digits = 1, mark = tr("big_mark"), dec.mark = tr("decimal_mark")) |>
  formatRound(num_cols[5], digits = 0, mark = tr("big_mark"), dec.mark = tr("decimal_mark"))
```

#| label: breakdown-table
breakdown_tbl <- breakdown |>
  left_join(species_info, by = "species") |>
  mutate(name_rank = str_rank(site_name, locale = "cs")) |>
  arrange(name_rank, species, kves, p_class_lower) |>
  transmute(
    !!tr("col_site_code") := site_code,
    !!tr("col_site_name") := site_name,
    !!tr("col_species") := common,
    !!tr("col_kves") := tr_kves(kves),
    !!tr("col_pclass") := fmt_pclass(p_class_lower, p_class_upper),
    !!tr("col_area") := area_ha,
    !!tr("col_share") := share_of_site_habitat_pct
  )

datatable(
  breakdown_tbl,
  elementId = "breakdown-table",
  rownames = FALSE,
  selection = "none",
  class = "compact hover",
  options = list(
    language = dt_language,
    pageLength = 15,
    lengthMenu = c(15, 30, 60, 120),
    order = list(),
    scrollX = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(list(className = "dt-right", targets = 5:6))
  ),
  callback = JS("window.phengarisBreakdown = table;")
) |>
  formatRound(names(breakdown_tbl)[6], digits = 2,
              mark = tr("big_mark"), dec.mark = tr("decimal_mark")) |>
  formatRound(names(breakdown_tbl)[7], digits = 1,
              mark = tr("big_mark"), dec.mark = tr("decimal_mark"))

## `r tr("sec_chart")` {#chart}

```{r}
#| label: chart
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 11
#| dev: ragg_png
#| fig-alt: !expr tr("chart_alt")
#| fig-cap: !expr tr("chart_caption", p_min = p_min_lab)
chart_data <- site_tbl |>
  mutate(
    panel = factor(common, levels = species_info$common),
    row = fct_reorder(paste(site_name, species, sep = "__"), habitat_ha)
  )

# AOPK ČR web palette and Franklin Gothic (ragg finds it by family name;
# without it the chart falls back to the default sans)
aopk_text <- "#36332a"
aopk_green <- "#006c4e"

ggplot(chart_data, aes(x = habitat_ha, y = row, fill = species)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  geom_text(aes(label = fmt_num(habitat_ha, 0.1)),
            hjust = -0.15, size = 3.2, colour = aopk_text, family = "Franklin Gothic Book") +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(panel), scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = \(x) sub("__.*$", "", x)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = \(x) fmt_num(x, 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = set_names(species_info$colour, species_info$species),
                    guide = "none") +
  labs(x = tr("chart_x"), y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12, base_family = "Franklin Gothic Book") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "#dcdad6", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = aopk_text),
    axis.title.x = element_text(colour = aopk_text, margin = margin(t = 8)),
    strip.text.y = element_text(family = "Franklin Gothic Demi", colour = aopk_green,
                                size = 12),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
  )
```
